articles.title: Raman suppression in nanophotonics enabled by multimode spectral filtering
articles.summary: We show that multimode spectral filtering in nanophotonic waveguides can effectively suppress Raman noise, paving the way for cleaner on-chip light sources and coherent photonic applications.
articles.author: Yunxiang Song†, Jinsheng Lu†, Xinrui Zhu, Danxian Liu, Zongda Li, Pawan Ratra, Norman Lippok, Miro Erkintalo, Federico Capasso*, Marko Lončar*

articles.title: Multimode Single-Ring Photonic Molecule
articles.summary: We demonstrate that a single microring resonator supporting multiple transverse modes behaves as a photonic molecule, exhibiting hybridized resonances and controllable mode splitting analogous to coupled quantum systems—all within one ring.
articles.author: Jinsheng Lu*, Ileana-Cristina Benea-Chelmus, Vincent Ginis, Marcus Ossiander, Danilo Shchepanovich, Federico Capasso*

articles.title: Cascaded-mode interferometers: Spectral shape and linewidth engineering
articles.summary: We introduce a new class of integrated photonic interferometers based on sequential mode conversions, enabling arbitrary spectral shaping and linewidth engineering far beyond the limits of conventional single-mode resonators.
articles.author: Jinsheng Lu*, Ileana-Cristina Benea-Chelmus, Vincent Ginis, Marcus Ossiander, Federico Capasso*

articles.title: Helicity and Polarization Gradient Optical Trapping in Evanescent Fields
articles.summary: We reveal that evanescent optical fields carry helicity and polarization gradients that generate novel trapping forces, enabling selective, chirality-sensitive manipulation of nanoparticles near waveguide surfaces.
articles.author: Jinsheng Lu, Vincent Ginis, Soon Wei Daniel Lim, Federico Capasso*

articles.title: Optical manipulation: from fluid to solid domains
articles.author: Qiannan Jia, Wei Lyu, Wei Yan*, Weiwei Tang*, Jinsheng Lu*, Min Qiu*

articles.title: Polarization-Dependent Forces and Torques at Resonance in a Microfiber-Microcavity System
articles.summary: We demonstrate precise control of optical forces and torques through polarization in a coupled microfiber–microcavity system, revealing a resonant mechanism for all-optical optomechanical actuation.
articles.author: Jinsheng Lu, Vincent Ginis*, Cheng-Wei Qiu, Federico Capasso*

articles.title: Resonators with tailored optical path by cascaded-mode conversions
articles.author: Vincent Ginis†*, Ileana-Cristina Benea-Chelmus†, Jinsheng Lu, Marco Piccardo, Federico Capasso*

articles.title: Micro-scale opto-thermo-mechanical actuation in the dry adhesive regime
articles.author: Weiwei Tang†, Wei Lyu†, Jinsheng Lu†, Fengjiang Liu, Jiyong Wang, Wei Yan*, Min Qiu*

articles.title: On-chip optical tweezers based on freeform optics
articles.summary: We realize chip-integrated optical tweezers using freeform metalenses that tightly focus light on-chip, enabling stable three-dimensional trapping and manipulation of micro-objects without bulk optics.
articles.author: Shaoliang Yu†*, Jinsheng Lu†, Vincent Ginis, Simon Kheifets, Soon Wei Daniel Lim, Min Qiu, Tian Gu, Juejun Hu, Federico Capasso

articles.title: Remote structuring of near-field landscapes
articles.summary: We show that near-field optical distributions can be remotely programmed by tailoring the spatial mode content of far-field beams, enabling reconfigurable nanoscale photonic landscapes without physical contact.
articles.author: Vincent Ginis*, Marco Piccardo, Michele Tamagnone, Jinsheng Lu, Min Qiu, Simon Kheifets, Federico Capasso*

articles.title: Nanoscale Lamb wave–driven motors in nonliquid environments
articles.summary: We demonstrate nanoscale rotary motors driven by acoustic Lamb waves on solid substrates in air, achieving controllable rotation of micro-objects without liquid media—a key step toward dry-environment optomechanical devices.
articles.author: Jinsheng Lu, Qiang Li, Cheng-Wei Qiu, Yu Hong, Pintu Ghosh, Min Qiu*

articles.title: Light-Induced Pulling and Pushing by the Synergic Effect of Optical Force and Photophoretic Force
articles.summary: We discover that the synergy of optical radiation pressure and photophoretic force enables a single laser beam to simultaneously push and pull absorbing particles, revealing a bidirectional light-driven transport mechanism.
